_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro: Ị bụ onye na-egwu egwuregwu {player_id} na Tic Tac Toe. Ihe mgbaru ọsọ gị bụ iji merie atọ n'usoro (na-agagharị agagharị, n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ, ma ọ bụ diagonal) na bọọdụ ahụ. Na ntụgharị gị, ị ga-ahọrọ nọmba square (0-8) ịchọrọ itinye akara gị na-esote. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, '[4]' na-etinye akara gị na cell etiti nke bọọdụ ahụ. Dị ka onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id}, ị ga-abụ '{symbol}', ebe onye iro gị bụ '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ihe a chọrọ ime abụghị ihe e dere n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} abụghị sel dị mma. Ọ ghaghị ịdị n'etiti 0 na 8.

game_action.placed: Onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} tinyere akara ha ({symbol}) na cell {cell}.
